<thoughts>The user wants to convert a goal into a structured tool call.
The goal is: 'Type 'Hello from Memory-Augmented Agent!' inside the open window.'

I need to identify which tool is appropriate for this goal.
Available tools:
- `windows.open_app (args: path)`: This tool opens an application. The goal implies a window is *already* open ("inside the open window"). So, this tool is not suitable for the typing action itself.
- `keyboard.type (args: text)`: This tool types text. The goal explicitly states 'Type 'Hello from Memory-Augmented Agent!'. This tool is a perfect match.

The `keyboard.type` tool requires a `text` argument.
The text to be typed is 'Hello from Memory-Augmented Agent!'.

So, the tool call will be `keyboard.type|text=Hello from Memory-Augmented Agent!`</thoughts>
keyboard.type|text=Hello from Memory-Augmented Agent!
